fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for ≤2 ADUs, ≈$295 on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis.

fee_items.fee_name: Park mitigation fee (ADU exempt)
fee_items.source_note: County-confirmed (FY 2024-25 budget response): 'accessory dwelling units (ADUs), fire rebuilds, and remodels do not pay Park Mitigation Fees' (standard rate $3,678/unit).

fee_items.fee_name: Fire district impact fee (ADU 800 sq ft, proportional)
fee_items.source_note: SCFD $1.62/sq ft or SVFD $1.72/sq ft × 800 (2021 nexus-study max rates; ADUs <750 exempt, ≥750 charged proportionately per Gov. Code §65852.2(f)(3)(A)).
fee_items.notes: Nexus-study max rates; county may have adopted at/below max. SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): collapses to 50-sq-ft basis.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (residential valuation tiers, 800 sq ft)
fee_items.source_note: Permit Sonoma FY 24-25: permit $2,163+$4.73/$1,000 + plan check $1,246+$5.79/$1,000; worked example at $200,000 valuation ≈ $4,461.
fee_items.notes: Valuation-dependent; no ADU-specific flat rate. SB 1117 does not change permit fees.

fee_items.fee_name: Parks development mitigation fee (Second Units, detached)

fee_items.notes: No fee for ADUs <750 sq ft (codified on DIMF sheets). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): marginal 50-sq-ft rule — schedule amendment expected.

fee_items.fee_name: Sewer capacity (Goleta West SD, detached ADU 800 sq ft)
fee_items.source_note: GWSD Ordinance No. 23-97: detached ADU = ADU sq ft ÷ 1,747 × $4,060 (SFR connection fee); 800 sq ft = $1,859. Attached ADUs and JADUs: no charge.
fee_items.notes: Applies in Goleta West SD service area (Isla Vista / western Goleta Valley). SB 1117 excludes connection/capacity charges.

fee_items.fee_name: County development impact fees (≤850 sq ft ADU)
fee_items.source_note: Sacramento County Code Ch. 16.152/16.150 (fire), 16.155 (park), 16.160 (library), 16.87 (SCTDF/transit): DIF not applied to ADUs ≤850 sq ft (≤1,000 sq ft multi-bedroom).
fee_items.notes: Codified 850 sq ft exemption — no 750 cliff; proportional above 850. SB 1117 changes nothing at 800 sq ft.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (R-3 Custom Homes Type VB, 800 sq ft)
fee_items.source_note: FY 26/27 Construction Fee Schedule LUS 16.0204(a)(1): R-3 Dwellings Custom Homes Type VA/VB $2,428 base @ 1,000 sq ft threshold (plan check + inspection combined). No ADU-specific line.
fee_items.notes: Interpretation: detached ADU classified under R-3 Dwellings. SB 1117 does not change permit fees.

fee_items.fee_name: General county DIF (none adopted)
fee_items.source_note: County never adopted a general countywide DIF program (2014 Housing Element, Table 5B-9 background). SBCTA regional transportation mitigation fee varies by sphere (separate line).

fee_items.source_note: CVUSD Res. 38-25/26 (adopted 3/11/2026, eff. 5/11/2026) and Hayward USD (Jan 2026): $5.38/sq ft residential; <500 sq ft exempt.

fee_items.fee_name: Park dedication fee (ADU ≥750 sq ft)
fee_items.source_note: County Zoning Ord. §17.55.160 + official ADU Process handout: $5,775 flat for ADUs ≥750 sq ft; $0 for ADUs <750 sq ft and JADUs.
fee_items.notes: Hard cliff codified. SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01) in tension with flat fee — county amendment pending; verify at 12/1.

fee_items.fee_name: Sewer connection fee (DSRSD, ADU)
fee_items.source_note: DSRSD connection fee table (Feb 2026): ADU $11.49/sq ft (regional $9.75 + local $1.74); 800 sq ft = $9,192.
fee_items.notes: Applies in DSRSD service area (East County / Dublin). SB 1117 excludes connection/capacity charges.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (800 sq ft detached ADU, foothills)
fee_items.source_note: Building Division Fee Schedule, eff. 7/1/2026. Table 3-A residential 0.007 x valuation ($193.11/sq ft foothills; $154,488 for 800 sq ft): core $1,544.88 ~ $1,545 (50% plan review + 50% permit + E/P/M). All-in with surcharges ~ $1,812 (Tahoe ~ $2,419).
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - permit fees excluded from SB 1117.

fee_items.fee_name: Traffic mitigation fee (ADU >=750 sq ft, proportional to primary dwelling)
fee_items.source_note: County formula (Traffic Fee Programs Annual Report, Exhibit B): 'Secondary dwellings >=750 SF = (2nd Dwelling SF / Primary Dwelling SF) x Fee per DUE'. FY25-26 schedule eff. 8/11/2025. Worked example: 800 sq ft ADU, 2,000 sq ft primary, Auburn/Bowman district ($6,833/DUE) = 40% x $6,833 ~ $2,733. District range $1,521-$4,378 (Tahoe to Sunset).
fee_items.notes: Soft 750 cliff (no hard step). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for <=2 ADUs, ~$171 on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis.

fee_items.fee_name: Deed-restricted ADU (>=750 sq ft): permit fees + traffic (15.28) + parks (15.34) waived
fee_items.source_note: Placer County Code 15.65.110(B): an owner voluntarily deed-restricting an ADU >=750 sq ft for affordability is exempt from building permit fees and the fees in Articles 15.28 (traffic) and 15.34 (parks). Only matrix jurisdiction with a deed-restriction ADU fee exemption.

fee_items.fee_name: City development impact fees (ADU >=750 sq ft, prorated to primary dwelling)
fee_items.source_note: EMMC 17.110.030 + FY25-26 fee schedule (eff. 7/1/2025): SFR DIF base $10,217.26 (sewer $1,652.38 + storm drain $985.03 + street $868.83 + park $6,430.44 + traffic $72.39 + tech 2.08% $208.19; Quimby excluded for ADUs). ADU fee = (800 / primary sq ft) x $10,217.26. Worked examples: $6,812 (1,200 sq ft primary); $4,087 (2,000 sq ft primary - shown).
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for <=2 ADUs, ~$213 on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis (city implementation method pending; verify at 12/1).

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (Baldwin Park USD)
fee_items.source_note: BPUSD Annual Developer Fee Report FY 2024-25 (adopted 12/9/2025): Level 1 $3.48/sq ft new residential (2018-era SAB rate). 800 sq ft ADU = $2,784. Additions <=500 sq ft exempt (SB 543).

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (SFR new-construction tiers, 800 sq ft)
fee_items.source_note: FY 2021-22 Citywide Fee Schedule Exhibit A-1 (eff. 9/6/2021), latest published: permit $500 min or $1.03/sq ft (800 x $1.03 = $824) + plan check $500 min or $1.01/sq ft (800 x $1.01 = $808) = $1,632.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - permit fees excluded from SB 1117.

fee_items.fee_name: Planning: ADU review (deposit)

fee_items.fee_name: Planning: site plan & design review (ADU 800-1,000 sq ft tier)
fee_items.source_note: Planning Fee Schedule Exhibit A-2 (current): Site Plan and Design Review - ADU, 800-1,000 sq ft tier $1,000. Detached ADUs >=800 sq ft require planning design review per ADU handout. Note: published tier reads 'greater than 800 sq ft' - exactly-800 sq ft boundary to confirm with Planning.

fee_items.fee_name: City development impact fees (ADU >=750 sq ft, prorated to primary dwelling)
fee_items.source_note: City ADU Ordinance Summary (Community Development Dept.): 'ADUs Equal to or Greater than 750 SF - Impact fees collected must be proportional to square footage of existing dwelling unit(s).' FY 2023-2025 Master Fee Schedule (Res. 2006.066, eff. 7/2/2006): SF-unit bundle $4,822.63 (police $413.32 + garage $145.70 + water facilities $1,381.25 + wastewater $347.17 + system $0.42 + parks/rec $2,270.10 + enhancements $35.02 + admin $229.65). Worked example: 800 sq ft ADU, 1,400 sq ft primary = $4,822.63 x 800/1,400 ~ $2,756.
fee_items.notes: Soft 750 cliff (onset of proration, not a hard step). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for <=2 ADUs, ~$172 on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis (illustrative 1,400 sq ft primary).

fee_items.fee_name: School district developer fee (Livermore Valley JUSD)
fee_items.source_note: City of Livermore Community Development Impact and Connection Fees, eff. 7/1/2026, Exhibit D: LVJUSD Summary of School Mitigation Program - $5.17/sq ft residential (LVJUSD Res. 083-23/24, eff. 8/12/2024). 800 sq ft ADU = $4,136. Additions <=500 sq ft exempt. Caveat: district's own 2026 posting not located; $5.38 adoption unverified.

fee_items.fee_name: Tri-Valley Transportation Development Fee (ADU/SDU)
fee_items.source_note: City fee sheet (eff. 7/1/2026): TVTD ADU/SDU = $0.00 explicit line item (per TVTC Resolution 2019-03; SFR pays $7,239.25/d.u.).

fee_items.source_note: Master Fee Schedule Res. 2026-108, New Construction Fees: R-3 800 sq ft (below 1,000 sq ft threshold), Type V-B (typical wood-frame ADU) $4,146 + 5% Technology Fee = $4,353.30 ~ $4,353. Whether plan review is included or billed separately was not established (verify at 12/1).
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - permit fees excluded from SB 1117.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (800 sq ft detached ADU, worked example)
fee_items.source_note: Building and Safety Division Fee Schedule (Revised May 19, 2026), valuation-based: permit $1,881 first $100k + $9.83/additional $1k; plan review 85% of permit minus $74 application; Title 24 energy 10%+10%, green 6%+6%, disabled access 10%+10%; electrical $0.36/sq ft, plumbing $0.14/sq ft; application $74 + combination issuance $133. Worked example: 800 sq ft at $120,000 declared valuation ($150/sq ft) = $2,077.60 permit + $1,691.96 plan review + $376.96 energy + $226.18 green + $376.96 disabled access + $288 electrical + $112 plumbing + $207 issuance = ~$5,357. Valuation is set by the Building Official (illustrative; actual ADU job values $40k-$150k per county usage data).
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - permit fees are not impact fees.

fee_items.fee_name: Camrosa Water District ADU application fee
fee_items.source_note: Ordinance 43-24 Schedule of Miscellaneous Fees and Charges (adopted 6/6/2024): ADU Application Fee $220.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - utility connection fees are excluded from SB 1117.

fee_items.fee_name: Camrosa water + wastewater capital improvement fees (ADU sharing primary meter/lateral)
fee_items.source_note: Ordinance 40-26 (adopted 4/14/2026): ADU sharing the primary dwelling's lateral = $0 wastewater Capital Improvement fees (§7.4.1.2.1); ADU sharing the primary meter = $0 water Capital Improvement fees (§4.1.1.2.1); even a separately-metered ADU on the primary service line = $0 (§4.1.1.2.2). Monthly wastewater charge increases by 1 EDU. New independent water service (new line + meter + account) triggers $2,500 (3/4", Area III) / $3,600 (Area II) / $4,800 (Area I); new independent lateral triggers Sewer Connection Fee $4,675/DU + $20/DU permit fee.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - utility connection fees are excluded from SB 1117.

fee_items.fee_name: Capital Facilities Fee (ADU >=750 sq ft, proportional to primary dwelling)
fee_items.source_note: CFF Policies and Procedures (City Council Resolution 2024-278, adopted 8/13/2024), Table 3: ADU <750 sq ft = No Charge. ADU >=750 sq ft = (ADU sq ft / primary dwelling sq ft) x Single-Family CFF rate, capped at Multi-Family rate. FY25-26 rates (eff. 7/1/2025-6/30/2026): SFR $18,146/DU, MF $12,250/DU (cap), Senior $11,268/DU. Worked example: 800 sq ft ADU / 1,800 sq ft primary x $18,146 = $8,064.89 ~ $8,065.
fee_items.notes: Soft 750 cliff (proportional, not full SFR rate). SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for <=2 ADUs, ~$504 on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis ((50/1,800) x $18,146) — ~93% drop.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (SMALL RESIDENTIAL UNIT, ADU flat)
fee_items.source_note: Confirmed on four issued ADU permits in the City's official eTRAKiT system (BLD2025-04370, BLD2025-02583, BLD2026-01124, BLD2025-04287): SMALL RESIDENTIAL UNIT $2,429 regardless of declared valuation ($35k-$145k) or square footage in this band. Split lines ($429+$2,000; $600+$1,829) indicate the $2,429 covers both permit and plan check. Typical all-in city permit cost ~$2,800-$3,170 with surcharges (fire, planning plan check, technology, general plan maintenance, green building, earthquake).
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - permit fees are not impact fees.

fee_items.fee_name: City development impact fees (ADU >=750 sq ft, proportional to primary dwelling)
fee_items.source_note: City of Vista Fees, July 2025 (UPDATED 07/01/2025). Full SFR DIF total $18,908.93/du: fire protection $379 + park fee $9,933.06 (eff. 8/14/2025) + public facilities $1,218 + streets and signal $7,378.87. ADU <750 sq ft = waived automatically (SB 13). ADU >=750 sq ft = proportionate to primary dwelling sq ft. Worked example: 800 sq ft ADU / 2,000 sq ft primary = 40% x $18,908.93 = $7,563.57 ~ $7,564. DIFs deferrable to completion of construction upon request. ADU Fee Waiver Program (Ord. 2019-11) can waive over-750 DIFs entirely with 10-year eligible-household covenant.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (800 sq ft detached ADU)
fee_items.source_note: Computed from official City of Vista Fees, July 2025 (B-PMTFVL / B-PLNCVL tables): 2021 ICC valuation table R-3 Type VB $165.67/sq ft x 800 = $132,536 valuation (set by the City). Permit $1,877.74 (first $100k) + 33 x $13.56 = $2,325.22; plan check $2,233.19 + 33 x $5.19 = $2,404.46; total ~$4,729.68 ~ $4,730. Plan check fees waived when a City pre-approved ADU plan is used (permit + inspection ~$2,325). Certificate of occupancy $104.40 separate.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - permit fees are not impact fees.

fee_items.fee_name: Building permit + plan check (800 sq ft detached ADU)
fee_items.source_note: Derived from the City's official 2026-2027 Building Permit Fee Schedule (effective 07/01/2026) + official Building Valuation table (2024 IBC): valuation 800 x $177.63/sq ft (R-3 one- and two-family, Type VB) = $142,104. Permit $2,270.86 (at $100k) + 43 x $13.44 = $2,848.78; plan check 81.2% of permit = $2,313.21; subtotal $5,161.99 ~ $5,162. Plus issuance $67.58+, archival 0.1% of valuation, GP surcharge 0.2%, SMIP 0.013%, green fee $1/$25k valuation. Electrical/plumbing/mechanical permits separately scheduled.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - permit fees are not impact fees.

fee_items.fee_name: ADU neighborhood notice fee
fee_items.source_note: Land Use Planning fee schedule, City Council Item 16 (9/30/2025, effective 11/1/2025): ADU Neighborhood Notice $500 (2 hours staff time), collected with building permit application.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - planning fees are not impact fees.

fee_items.fee_name: ADU plan check - zoning certificate (ministerial review)

fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - planning fees are not impact fees.

fee_items.fee_name: ADU plan check - building permit review
fee_items.source_note: Land Use Planning fee schedule, City Council Item 16 (9/30/2025, effective 11/1/2025): ADU Plan Check (Building Permit review) $250 (1 hour). Pre-approved gallery designs qualify for 50% plan-check fee reduction.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - planning fees are not impact fees.

fee_items.fee_name: City development impact fees on ADU
fee_items.source_note: City ADU FAQs (v. 2/9/2026): 'Land Use Planning does not assess impact fees.' Affordable housing in-lieu fee $62.83/sq ft RUFA (BMC 23.328, Reso No. 72,418-N.S. adopted 7/28/2026): SFR projects deduct 2,500 sq ft from RUFA, so an 800 sq ft ADU on a single-family lot nets $0. Other city impact fees (SOSIP, POPOS, public art, commercial) are geographically/typologically inapplicable to a standalone ADU. Caveat: BMC 23.328 applicability to standalone ADUs not explicitly verified.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no effect — Berkeley city DIF base on ADUs is $0.

fee_items.fee_name: City development impact fees — ADU-specific flat (DI-36 law enforcement $189 + DI-37 fire $89 + DI-38 library $219 + DI-39 parkland/open space $3,224)
fee_items.source_note: City of Huntington Beach Master Fee & Charges Schedule FY 2026/27 (eff. 7/1/2026): dedicated 'Accessory Dwelling per Unit' DIF line items — DI-36 $189 + DI-37 $89 + DI-38 $219 + DI-39 $3,224 = $3,721 per ADU. Parkland/open space = 87% of total.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): for <=2 ADUs, impact fees on the 50-sq-ft-above-750 basis only — ~$233 ((50/800) x $3,721), ~94% drop. City's 2027 flat-fee methodology not yet published.

fee_items.source_note: OC San Table A FY 2026/27: 'Residential Accessory Structures, and Accessory Dwelling Units' at the Average Demand rate $1,710 per 1,000 sq ft (or portion thereof); an 800 sq ft ADU = one block = $1,710. Minimum charge does not apply to ADUs.
fee_items.notes: SB 1117 (eff. 2027-01-01): no change - connection/capacity charges are excluded from SB 1117.

Code §66324. Worked example: $4.203 x 800 x (800/1,500 primary, series assumption) = $1,792.80 ~ $1,793. ADUs <750 sq ft = $0 (printed in schedule).

fee_items.source_note: Citywide Fee Schedule eff. 1/1/2026: city's Square Foot Construction Valuation table (p. 37) R-3 Type VB $220/sq ft → 800 x $220 = $176,000 valuation; Table 3A (PL-BLD10): $2,132 + $3.00/add'l $1,000 over $100k = $2,132 + 76 x $3 = $2,360. Accessible copy is the April 2024 edition; current September 2025 edition returned 403 — waiver rule confirmed, current rate levels at 12/1 re-verification.
